title: Speed Triple 1200 RR (Apex Spec)
description: Representing Triumph's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Triumph Speed Triple 1200 RR (Apex Spec) is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 1200cc powerplant pumps out 154 HP and 123 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
